name: contributor-pr-review
description: Review one frozen contributor PR (default: #40 clash log, issue #29): inspect its diff against the issue's acceptance list, run the affected checks, replay it in headless Chrome from a local HTTP build with the opt-in flag on and off, and report concrete bugs and acceptance gaps. Read-only for source; artifacts go to .artifacts/kiro/contributor-review-40/.

steps.prompt: Review candidate 4fb0f88eeb5109d38db367f1fbcaf4c4fe8589ce (PR #40) against base c65f49e7bd70ef81244d83d906f9e6521bef3020. Do not edit any file. First run `git rev-parse HEAD` and `git diff --stat c65f49e7bd70ef81244d83d906f9e6521bef3020 4fb0f88eeb5109d38db367f1fbcaf4c4fe8589ce` and confirm the six changed files are src/main.js, src/match/clash-log.js, src/ui/card-model.js, src/ui/cards.js, src/ui/match.css and tests/match/clash-log.test.js; report any difference. Read the full diff of those six files, the '# Issue 29' section of .artifacts/dispatch-inputs/feature-briefs.md (the acceptance list) and .artifacts/dispatch-inputs/pr40.md (the author's claims). For each acceptance item give: met / not met / unverifiable by reading, with file and line evidence. Look for concrete behavior bugs: stale or lost events between roundEvents and the clash, log state across a new match, anything visible or added to the DOM without ?log=1, hidden Wizard information, live-region announcements repeating, layout overlap. Do not report style preferences. Give each finding a severity (bug, acceptance gap, or note) and a reproduction idea. Write the result to .artifacts/kiro/contributor-review-40/inspect-diff.md and put the same content in the final response.
